text: Decision: we're going with Postgres + pgvector for the embedding store. We already run Postgres, there's no new infra to babysit, and pgvector handles our current 200k vectors comfortably.
From the finance side the only hard constraint is that we keep vector infrastructure under $200 per month. pgvector on the existing box adds $0, so that works for me.
Agreed for now. Flagging that we have not load tested past 500k vectors, so this may need revisiting once the corpus grows.
